title: Day 0
body:
6:17 pm

Test post. Passed the day in CP in Blue Tokai. They really do just let you sit here without asking you to leave. It's been me and two others with rucksacks who've been holding down our spots since like, 1 pm. I built this website in that time. 

Bus from Kashmiri Gate at 9:15 pm today. Will head around 8:00 pm, should reach by 8:30. Got some protein bars. Need to find bananas if I can. Water. And a head pillow thing if I come across.

Testing images. Cascara from Blue Tokai.
